newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks set new intraday record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks set new intraday record.

text.p: Mexican stocks extended their earlier gains at midday Wednesday to rack up a new trading record.
Dealers said greater stability in the money and foreign exchange markets encouraged buyers amid less market uncertainty over forthcoming mid-term elections.
"Last night's Cetes hikes eased pressure on the peso and the market is discounting elections, which is why they're buying," a trader said.
The leading IPC share index was up 22.46 points, or 0.54 percent, at 4,165.38.
